A Stay Shaped by the Wild
Safari View Camps & Lodges
Set within the breathtaking landscapes of Tanzania, Safari View Camps and Lodges offers thoughtfully appointed tented stays where comfort, wilderness and warm Tanzanian hospitality come together in a truly memorable safari setting. Surrounded by vast open plains, beautiful natural scenery and the timeless atmosphere of the African bush, our camps provide a peaceful place to slow down, relax and reconnect with the landscapes you have travelled so far to experience.
Each stay is designed to complement your safari journey, offering welcoming accommodation, comfortable spaces and a sense of closeness to nature without losing the warmth and ease that make a place feel inviting. Spend your days discovering Tanzania’s remarkable wildlife and iconic safari destinations, then return to the calm of camp to enjoy quiet moments, shared stories and the changing colours of the wilderness. At Safari View Camps and Lodges , every stay is about more than accommodation; it is an opportunity to experience Tanzania at a gentler pace, create lasting safari memories and feel genuinely connected to the extraordinary places around you.

Unforgettable moments, timeless elegance, and the Serengeti at your doorstep
Why Stay With Us?
A true luxury tented camp in Serengeti should feel effortless: refined comfort, reliable essentials, and thoughtful spaces that enhance your safari experience in Ikoma near Serengeti National Park. Below are 8 high-value facilities guests commonly expect in premium Serengeti tented camps (you can tailor these to exactly what Lucky Maasai offers).
Exquisite Luxury Suites
Handcrafted tents with private decks, floor-to-ceiling savanna views, and modern indulgences for unmatched comfort.
Prime Serengeti Location
Perched atop the Lomoti kopjes, offering panoramic vistas of the golden plains and Big Five wildlife encounters.
Authentic African Design
Locally sourced cedarwood, handwoven textiles, and Maasai-inspired decor immerse you in the culture of the land.
Gourmet Bush Dining
Exquisite meals served under the open sky, from private sundowners to intimate candlelit dinners around the campfire.
Eco-Luxury Commitment
Solar energy, rainwater conservation, and responsible waste management ensure sustainability without compromising luxury.
Personalized Experiences
Every detail tailored to you, from exclusive wildlife moments to curated evening experiences, making your stay uniquely yours.
Frequently
Asked Questions
Whether you’re planning your first safari or returning for a new adventure, here are answers to our guests’ most common inquiries.
What Is Included In The Nightly Rate?
Your rate covers luxury tent accommodation, all meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and sundowners). Any extras such as spa treatments, bar tabs, and private guided excursions are billed separately.
When is the best time to visit Safari View Luxury Camp?
The Serengeti’s beauty evolves throughout the year.  High season  (July–October) features the epic Great Migration crossings and peak wildlife activity.  Shoulder seasons  (late June & November) offer fewer guests, lush green landscapes, and plentiful migratory birds.  Low season  (December–March) brings newborn wildebeest calves, vibrant plains, and more attractive rates ideal for photographers and budget-conscious travelers.
What dietary requirements can we accommodate?
Our culinary team prides itself on personalization. Whether you’re vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, or have other allergies, simply let us know in advance. We source fresh, local ingredients and will craft bespoke menus that honor both your preferences and the region’s flavors.
How reliable is Wi-Fi and phone connectivity?
Our  Nomadic Wi-Fi Lounge  provides reliable connectivity with strong signal for essential emails and social updates. Each suite features solar-powered outlets so you can charge devices at any time.
What is your cancellation and amendment policy?
We understand plans can change. Cancellations made  60 days or more  before arrival incur no fee. Between  30–59 days , a 50% cancellation fee applies. Within  30 days , the full booking cost is non-refundable. Date or suite amendments are subject to availability and seasonal rate differences; please contact us as early as possible.
How do I reach Safari View Luxury Camp from the nearest airstrip?
We can Arrange the Transfers for You. After your light-aircraft flight into the Serengeti’s private airstrip, our 4×4 vehicles driven by expert guides will be waiting to transport you the short distance to camp. The drive through rolling grasslands is an extension of your safari experience.

Our Luxury Tented Rooms

Our Rooms
Comfort, privacy, and wilderness views
Experience luxury in the heart of the Serengeti
Our luxury tented rooms at Safari View Luxury Camp are designed to offer comfort, privacy, and an authentic Serengeti safari experience. Set in the heart of Central Serengeti, each tent blends elegant safari style with modern comfort, allowing guests to relax while surrounded by the beauty and sounds of the African wilderness. Whether traveling solo, as a couple, with friends, or as a family, our camp offers a variety of tented room options to suit every type of safari traveler.
Everything you need for a comfortable stay
Amenities in All Rooms
All rooms at Safari View Luxury Camp are designed to provide comfort, relaxation, and an authentic safari experience while maintaining modern convenience. Each tent is carefully furnished to ensure guests enjoy a comfortable stay in the heart of the Serengeti, with essential amenities, elegant interiors, and beautiful views of the surrounding wilderness.
Complimentary bottled drinking water
Comfortable beds with premium linens
Solar lighting and charging points
24-hour camp assistance
Writing desk and seating area
Wardrobe or luggage rack
En-suite bathroom with hot shower
Daily housekeeping service
Luxury Single Tent
Designed for individual travelers
The Single Tented Room is perfect for solo travelers seeking comfort and privacy while exploring the Serengeti. The tent is spacious and elegantly designed with a comfortable bed, en-suite bathroom, and a private veranda where guests can relax and enjoy views of the surrounding savannah. It offers a peaceful and comfortable retreat after a day of safari adventures.
Luxury Double Tent
Perfect for couples
The Double Tented Room is ideal for couples or travelers who prefer a large bed. The tent offers a spacious interior, elegant safari-style furnishings, and a private veranda overlooking the Serengeti landscape. It provides a comfortable and relaxing environment, perfect for couples looking to enjoy a romantic safari experience in the heart of the wilderness.
Twin Safari Tent
Perfect for friends or travel partners
The Twin Tented Room is designed for friends, travel partners, or guests who prefer separate beds. The tent includes two comfortable beds, an en-suite bathroom, and a private seating area. With beautiful views of the surrounding nature, the twin tent provides comfort, convenience, and a relaxing safari atmosphere.
Triple Safari Tent
Spacious tent for three guests
The Triple Tented Room is perfect for small groups or families traveling together. The tent is spacious and well designed to accommodate three guests comfortably while maintaining privacy and comfort. Guests can enjoy a relaxing environment with all the necessary amenities while experiencing the beauty of the Serengeti.
Family Interconnected Tents
Perfect for families traveling together
The Family Interconnected Room consists of two interconnected tents designed for families or groups who want to stay close together while still enjoying privacy and comfort. These rooms offer spacious sleeping areas, en-suite bathrooms, and a comfortable environment for families exploring the Serengeti together.

About Safari View Luxury Camp
Home
About Us
Luxury, wilderness, and authentic safari hospitality
Our Story in the Serengeti
Safari View Luxury Camp was created from a deep passion for the Serengeti and a commitment to providing authentic safari hospitality combined with comfort and personalized service. Located in the Seronera area of Central Serengeti, our camp offers guests a unique opportunity to experience the beauty, wildlife, and peaceful atmosphere of one of the world’s most famous national parks while staying in elegant luxury tented accommodation.
Our camp is designed to blend seamlessly with the natural environment, allowing guests to feel connected to the wilderness while enjoying comfort, privacy, and warm hospitality. At Safari View Luxury Camp, we believe that a safari is not just about seeing wildlife, but about experiencing nature, relaxing in beautiful surroundings, and creating unforgettable memories in the heart of Africa.
The Safari View Experience
Creating unforgettable Serengeti experiences
Our philosophy is centered around providing a comfortable, authentic, and memorable safari experience for every guest. We focus on personalized service, attention to detail, and creating a peaceful environment where guests can relax and enjoy the beauty of the Serengeti. Whether guests come for wildlife, relaxation, adventure, or a romantic getaway, our goal is to make every stay special and unforgettable.
Our Commitment to Guests
Our team is dedicated to providing warm, friendly, and professional service to ensure every guest enjoys a comfortable and memorable stay. From the moment guests arrive at the camp, our staff is committed to providing personalized service, delicious meals, comfortable accommodation, and assistance with safari activities to make every stay special.
Safari View Luxury Camp invites you to experience the beauty, wildlife, and peaceful atmosphere of the Serengeti while enjoying comfortable accommodation and authentic safari hospitality. Whether you are visiting for adventure, relaxation, or a special occasion, we look forward to welcoming you to the heart of the Serengeti.
